description: Publish an existing material owned by this active Coach-Token's original author; foreign correction grants and staff credentials never authorize publication. Read online_article_get first and supply its current revision. Managed drafts REQUIRE explicit languages: a nonempty unique ru/en subset approved for publication; each selected locale must have its own title and every text body. Complete text alone never approves another locale. Only selected locales become public. Legacy unmanaged articles preserve existing behavior when languages is omitted. Makes the article active with a publication timestamp, immediately public. Confirm final wording and each selected language before calling.
name: online_article_publish
